description: This file handles processing of inbound attachments in a QQ bot context, including downloading, converting, transcribing voice attachments, and classifying attachments into images, voice, or other types. It exports functions for processing attachments and formatting voice transcripts.

methods.name: processAttachments
methods.description: Downloads, converts, transcribes, and classifies inbound attachments, returning a structured object with URLs, paths, and transcripts.

methods.name: formatVoiceText
methods.description: Formats an array of voice transcripts into a user-visible string.
